description: Chrome-side sync engine for Zen Browser sidebar state (capture, digest diff, apply).

types.description: One sync record: id is Zen's native id (tab zenSyncId / folder DOM id / space uuid / split groupId / container guid / 'layout').

functions.name: start
functions.description: Initializes the engine (event listeners, capture scheduler) and returns the environment.

functions.name: stop
functions.description: Stops event listeners and capture scheduling.

functions.name: getEnvironment
functions.description: Returns { spacesEngineEnabled, fxaConfigured, zenVersion, compatible, missing, ready, guardSuppressed }.

functions.name: setSpacesEnginePref
functions.description: Sets services.sync.engine.spaces (Zen's native FxA spaces sync engine).

functions.name: getFullProjection
functions.description: Returns every current record as [{id, kind, data}].

functions.name: computeLocalChanges
functions.description: Diff of current projections vs the uploaded baseline: { changed: [SyncRecord], deleted: [ids] }.

functions.name: forceCapture
functions.description: Forces a fresh session collection (and with it a diff pass).

functions.name: getCounts
functions.description: Record counts for the popup: { spaces, folders, essentials, pinned, normal, splits }.

functions.name: applyRecords
functions.description: Applies incoming records/deletions to the live browser. Returns { failed: [ids], guard }.

reconcile.description: Initial 'Replace local': also delete local synced items absent from the incoming set.

overrideGuard.description: Bypass the apply-side mass-deletion guard (only after explicit user confirmation).

functions.name: reconnectMerge
functions.description: Applies the server's full record set while preserving offline changes/deletions. Returns { failed, guard }.

functions.name: markUploaded
functions.description: Advances the uploaded baseline from the server-acknowledged SENT payload (records upserted, ids deleted).

functions.name: getGeneration
functions.description: Server store generation this profile last synced against (null if never).

functions.name: resetBaseline
functions.description: Wipes the uploaded baseline (container mappings survive).

events.name: onRecordsChanged
events.description: Fired after each fresh capture whose diff is non-empty: { changed: [SyncRecord], deleted: [ids] }.

events.name: onEnvironmentChanged
events.description: Fired when the environment changes (e.g. services.sync.engine.spaces flips).
